report:
## stays-dbpr: every State-licensed hotel and motel in Hillsborough, Pinellas, Pasco and Manatee counties not already in data/stays.json

**Source.** The Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation (DBPR), Division of Hotels and Restaurants, "Lodging – Public Records" page (https://www2.myfloridalicense.com/hotels-restaurants/lodging-public-records/), which links the active-license extracts by district and documents the field layout ("Hotels and Restaurants Active Licensure Base"), the license type/rank codes (2001 Hotel HOTL, 2002 Motel MOTL, 2003 Apartment NAPT/TAPT, 2004 Rooming House, 2005 Bed & Breakfast, 2006 Resort Condominium, 2007 Resort Dwelling), the status codes (primary 20 Current, 45 Delinquent …; secondary 20 Active, 10 Inactive) and the region/county table. Hillsborough (39), Pasco (61) and Pinellas (62) are in district 3 (hrlodge3.csv); Manatee (51) is in district 7 (hrlodge7.csv). Both extracts were read in full on Sep 27, 2026 from their https URLs (HTTP Last-Modified Mon, 21 Sep 2026); WebFetch of the same URLs returns the identical header and rows but truncates these 6–8 MB files, so the full files were downloaded from the same URLs and parsed. Every record's source_url is the extract that holds its license; also_sources is the DBPR page. Nothing in a record comes from anywhere else, except Bungalow Beach Resort's status_note and url (its own site, read today).

**What each record says.** name = the DBPR business (DBA) name in normal case (brand spellings fixed: Hampton Inn & Suites, SpringHill Suites, TownePlace, WoodSpring, HomeTowne, La Quinta Inn & Suites, Fairfield Inn & Suites, SureStay; acronyms kept; "(THE)" moved to the front; legal suffixes LLC/INC and internal chain property numbers such as "#8011" dropped, with a note); kind = hotel or motel from the license rank, or extended-stay when the name is an extended-stay brand (Extended Stay America/ESA, WoodSpring, HomeTowne, Home2, Homewood, Residence Inn, TownePlace, Staybridge, Candlewood, InTown Suites, Uptown Suites, or "Extended Stay" in the name); brand/collection only when the name plainly carries a chain (Hilton, Marriott, IHG, Hyatt, Choice Hotels, Wyndham, Best Western, Sonesta, Extended Stay America, Red Roof, G6, and Radisson for Country Inn & Suites, matching data/stays.json's conventions); rooms = DBPR "Number of Seats or Rental Units"; address/city/zip from the DBPR location fields (city spellings normalized: "CLEARWATER BCH" → Clearwater Beach, "ST PETE" → St. Petersburg; ZIP 33767 addresses filed as "Clearwater" are given city Clearwater Beach); summary = only the licensing fact ("Licensed by the State of Florida as a motel with 16 rental units."); status open (a current, active license; all but two were inspected by DBPR between Jul 2025 and Sep 2026); url null (no property pages were read, except Bungalow Beach); notes = license number, class, status codes, expiry, last inspection date, county, the verbatim DBPR business name, any address correction and the geocode match. Licensee names were deliberately left out (many are private individuals).

**Counts.** 315 stays records from 317 licenses (two pairs of licenses were merged: ORANGE MOTEL 400 (1736 Gulf To Bay Blvd, Clearwater; MOT6209569 → merged into MOT6200043); JOHN'S PASS HOTEL (111 Boardwalk Pl E, Madeira Beach; HOT6215854 → merged into HOT6215835)).
- By county: Pinellas 138, Hillsborough 82, Manatee 74, Pasco 21.
- By license class: Motel (MOTL) 239, Hotel (HOTL) 76; county × class: Pinellas MOTL 111, Hillsborough MOTL 70, Manatee MOTL 42, Manatee HOTL 32, Pinellas HOTL 27, Pasco MOTL 16, Hillsborough HOTL 12, Pasco HOTL 5.
- By kind: motel 235, hotel 60, extended-stay 20.
- By area: bradenton-anna-maria 64, downtown-clearwater 24, north-tampa 19, seminole-heights 19, clearwater-beach 17, largo 14, east-tampa 13, grand-central 13, brandon 12, lutz-wesley-chapel 12, northeast-stpete 12, downtown-stpete 11, sarasota 10, st-pete-beach 9, west-pasco 9, south-stpete 8, treasure-island 8, apollo-beach 5, west-tampa 5, dunedin 4, indian-rocks-beach 4, old-northeast 4, madeira-beach 3, west-stpete 3, westshore 3, oldsmar 2, south-tampa 2, tampa-heights 2, palm-harbor 1, plant-city 1, tarpon-springs 1, temple-terrace 1.
- By brand: none (independent or unbranded name) 239, Choice Hotels 23, Marriott 11, Hilton 9, Wyndham 7, Extended Stay America 6, IHG 6, Red Roof 6, G6 3, Best Western 2, Hyatt 1, Radisson 1, Sonesta 1.
- Coordinates: 133 from an OpenStreetMap feature (Photon; the named hotel/motel feature, accepted only when its name matched and it lay within 400 m of the Census address point, or had the same house number), 175 from a Census address match, 7 without coordinates: Abode Beach House (455 S Gulf View Blvd, Clearwater Beach); Blue Moon Inn (2920 N Alt 19 N, Dunedin); Crystal Springs Inn (6736 Gall Blvd, Zephyrhills); Extended Stay America Premier Suites (6780 Lakeview Center Dr, Tampa); Grand Boulevard Efficiency Motel (7804 Grand Blvd, Port Richey); La Quinta Inn & Suites Clearwater South (5000 Lake Blvd, Clearwater); Motel 301 (3411 N US Highway 301, Tampa). John's Pass Hotel's point is the OSM street John's Way in John's Pass Village (noted).

**How the list was built (exclusion rules, in order).** The two extracts hold 50,025 lodging licenses; 19,817 are in the four counties: 9,585 resort dwellings (DWEL), 6,745 resort condominiums (CNDO), 2,609 nontransient apartments (NAPT), 151 transient apartments (TAPT), 35 bed & breakfasts (BNB), 336 hotels (HOTL) and 356 motels (MOTL).
